vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gws-gmail-reply
Version: 1.0.12

The skill bundle provides documentation and instructions for an AI agent to use the 'gws' CLI tool to reply to Gmail messages. The SKILL.md file outlines standard email functionality, including threading, attachments, and HTML support, without any evidence of malicious intent, prompt injection, or unauthorized data access.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper around an existing 'gws' CLI for replying to Gmail messages and its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim to reply to Gmail messages and the only required runtime artifact is the 'gws' CLI, which is appropriate for that purpose. No unrelated binaries or credentials are requested by this skill itself.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md simply documents invoking 'gws gmail +reply' and flags. It delegates auth/global flags to ../gws-shared/SKILL.md; that delegation is reasonable but means runtime behavior depends on that shared file (or on running 'gws generate-skills'), so review gws-shared for any expanded actions (auth flows, config writes).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — minimal footprint and nothing written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no environment variables, but it relies on the 'gws' CLI and a separate gws-shared SKILL.md for auth. Credentials are likely handled by that shared configuration or the CLI; inspect gws-shared to confirm which secrets/config paths are used and ensure they are proportional.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not 'always: true' and does not request persistent elevation. The only potential persistence is via the underlying gws CLI or generation step ('gws generate-skills') which may create local config or tokens; that's outside this skill's own code.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a lightweight wrapper that runs the 'gws' CLI to compose/reply to Gmail messages. Before installing: (1) Verify the 'gws' binary on your system is from a trusted source and understand what credentials it uses (OAuth tokens, local config files, environment variables). (2) Open ../gws-shared/SKILL.md (or run 'gws generate-skills' yourself in a controlled way) to see how auth and global flags are handled and whether any credentials or files will be created or stored. (3) Be aware the skill can send email and attach files — only allow it to access attachments you trust. If gws-shared requests unrelated credentials, network endpoints, or writes unexpected config files, treat that as a red flag and do not proceed.
